end.parentNote: Manav practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, omnivores, and simple food chains. They used the method of identifying the plant first and following the arrows; the food-chain sequence was completed correctly later in the lesson. At home, ask Manav to sort a few animals into the three groups and explain one food chain aloud.
